The Resideo DS06-102-DUT-LF is a 1 in DialSet pressure regulating valve for potable water with double union threaded (NPT) connections. It is installed on a water supply line to reduce a higher inlet pressure to a set outlet pressure. The outlet pressure is adjusted on the calibrated dial from 25 to 90 psi. The maximum inlet pressure rating is 250 psi, the reducing ratio is up to 10:1, and the maximum water temperature is 140 °F. The body is bronze with a 1/4 in NPT gauge tap on each side.

Key Features

  • Calibrated DialSet adjustment dial; outlet pressure range 25 to 90 psi
  • Maximum inlet pressure rating 250 psi; reducing ratio 10:1 maximum
  • Bronze body with fabric-reinforced diaphragm, stainless steel and engineered thermoplastic parts
  • Union fittings: double union threaded; body has female NPT inlet and outlet threads and external threads for unions
  • Two 1/4 in NPT gauge taps, one on each side of the body
  • For potable water up to 140 °F
  • ASSE 1003 certified, CSA B356 certified and IAPMO listed

Applications

  • Reducing water supply pressure on potable water lines
  • 1 in supply piping where a set outlet pressure between 25 and 90 psi is required
  • Threaded piping where the valve is connected through union tailpieces
  • Installations where the valve should come out of the line from either side

Before You Order

  • Pipe size: this valve is 1 in
  • Connection: double union, threaded (NPT); compare with the existing valve and piping
  • Inlet pressure: no higher than 250 psi and within the 10:1 reducing ratio of the outlet setting
  • Outlet pressure needed: must fall between 25 and 90 psi
  • Space: union body without tailpieces measures 6-15/16 in high x 3-15/16 in long

The Resideo VR8345M4302 is a 24 Vac, single-stage, standard-opening gas valve for gas-fired appliances with intermittent pilot or direct ignition systems. It has a straight-through body with 3/4 in x 3/4 in inlet and outlet and comes with two 3/4 x 1/2 in reducer bushings. The regulator is set at 3.5 in wc for natural gas, and a natural-to-LP conversion kit is included. Capacity is 300,000 Btuh at 1 in wc pressure drop, with a range of 30,000 to 415,000 Btuh on natural gas.

Key Features

  • 24 Vac, 50/60 Hz operator with 1/4 in quick-connect male terminals
  • 3/4 in x 3/4 in straight-through body; two 3/4 x 1/2 in reducer bushings included
  • Standard pressure regulator set at 3.5 in wc; 1/8 in NPT pressure tap with plug
  • Natural gas as shipped; natural-to-LP conversion kit included
  • Pilot gas outlet with compression fitting for 1/4 in OD tubing
  • Mounts 0 to 90 degrees in any direction from the upright position of the gas control knob, including vertically
  • Ambient temperature range -40 °F to 175 °F; pressure rating 1/2 psi

Applications

  • Single-stage gas appliances with intermittent pilot ignition
  • Single-stage gas appliances with direct ignition (direct spark or hot surface)
  • Natural gas appliances, or LP appliances after conversion with the included kit
  • Appliances with 1/2 in gas piping, using the included reducer bushings

Before You Order

  • Model number on the existing gas valve and the appliance manufacturer's parts list
  • Ignition system: intermittent pilot or direct ignition, 24 Vac control
  • Inlet and outlet pipe size (3/4 in, or 1/2 in with the bushings)
  • Gas type and manifold pressure: regulator is set at 3.5 in wc for natural gas
  • Appliance input within 30,000 to 415,000 Btuh on natural gas
  • Opening characteristic: this valve is standard opening, not slow or step opening

The Resideo AMX300TLF is a lead-free water heater mixing valve kit made up of a 3/4 in DirectConnect thermostatic mixing valve, a 3/4 in cold water tee and an 8 in stainless steel flex connector. The valve has a female NPT hot inlet and a male NPT mixed outlet, and blends hot and cold water to a mixed outlet temperature adjustable from 100 °F to 145 °F. Flow coefficient is 2.3 Cv, maximum operating pressure is 150 psi and minimum flow is 0.25 gpm.

Key Features

  • Mixed outlet temperature adjustable from 100 °F to 145 °F with a handwheel
  • Kit contents: 3/4 in mixing valve, 3/4 in cold water tee, 8 in stainless steel flex connector
  • Check valves on the hot and cold inlets
  • 1/2 in NPT recirculation port and 1/2 in NPT alternate hot port

  • Teflon-coated, nickel-plated brass valve body with EPDM seals
  • ASSE 1017 certified and CSA listed; lead free

Applications

  • Domestic hot water tempering at a tank water heater
  • Water heaters with 3/4 in NPT hot and cold connections
  • Domestic hot water systems with a recirculation line, using the 1/2 in NPT recirculation port

Before You Order

  • Water heater connections: 3/4 in NPT hot outlet and cold inlet
  • Flex connector length: this kit has the 8 in connector (AMX302TLF has 11 in)
  • Adapters are not included; check what is needed between the kit and the house piping
  • Required mixed water temperature within 100 °F to 145 °F
  • System pressure no higher than 150 psi

The Honeywell Home VC6934ZZ11 is a 24 Vac floating actuator for VC Series hydronic valve bodies. It takes an SP3T (tri-state) floating control signal over three wires, mounts directly on the valve, and drives the cartridge through a 0.4 in stroke in 120 seconds, staying in place when the signal is removed. It has a 5 ft plenum-rated cable and a flexible conduit adapter, draws 6 VA, and closes off against up to 60 psid. Maximum fluid temperature is 203 °F.

Key Features

  • 24 Vac, 50/60 Hz, 6 VA; SP3T (tri-state) floating control
  • 120 second drive time; 0.4 in (10 mm) maximum stroke; stays in place on loss of signal
  • 5 ft plenum-rated cable; flexible conduit adapter included
  • Direct-coupled mounting; the actuator head can be installed without draining the system
  • Close-off differential pressure up to 60 psid
  • Double insulated, IP40 plastic housing; no internal auxiliary switch
  • Ambient temperature 32 °F to 150 °F; fluid temperature up to 203 °F

Applications

  • Floating control of VC Series two-way and three-way hydronic valves
  • Cold, warm and hot water systems
  • Controllers with a 24 Vac tri-state (open/close) output
  • Installations that call for plenum-rated cable

Before You Order

  • Model number on the existing actuator: VC6934 is floating control, not on/off (VC8) or 2-10 Vdc modulating (VC7)
  • Valve body and cartridge series: store data lists this actuator for 3000 Series 2-way and 7000 Series VC valve bodies
  • Control signal from the controller: 24 Vac SP3T floating, three wires
  • Cable: 5 ft plenum cable rather than a Molex connector
  • No auxiliary (end) switch on this model

The Resideo ST9120U1011 is a universal electronic fan timer for gas warm air furnaces. It integrates control of the combustion blower and the circulating fan, runs on 24 Vac control voltage (18 to 30 Vac), and switches 120 V or 240 V line voltage loads. Heat and cool fan delays are set with DIP switches: heat fan on at 30 or 60 seconds and heat fan off at 60, 120, 150 or 180 seconds. Terminals are provided for an electronic air cleaner and a humidifier.

Key Features

  • DIP switch selectable heat fan on delay (30 or 60 s) and off delay (60, 120, 150 or 180 s)
  • Cool fan on delay 4 or 30 s; cool fan off delay 30 or 60 s
  • Circulating fan rating for heat-cool speed: 15 A full load, 30 A locked rotor at 115 Vac
  • Combustion blower rating: 1.5 A full load, 10 A locked rotor at 115 Vac
  • Electronic air cleaner and humidifier terminals; optional continuous low speed fan circulation
  • Replaceable fuse; 5 second postpurge
  • Ambient temperature range -40 °F to 175 °F; UL listed and CSA certified

Applications

  • Gas warm air furnaces with an electronic fan timer board
  • Furnaces with a combustion (induced draft) blower and a multi-speed circulating fan
  • Systems with an electronic air cleaner or humidifier wired to the furnace control

Before You Order

  • Part number on the existing fan timer and the Resideo cross reference for the ST9120U
  • Control voltage 24 Vac and line voltage 120 V or 240 V
  • Fan and combustion blower motor currents within the ratings above
  • Existing delay settings, so the DIP switches can be set to match
  • Wiring harness and terminal layout on the furnace
